# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the live site at https://utkarsh-singhal.is-a.dev and the latest commit on `main` are supported.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for security problems.

Report privately through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Utkarsh-Singhal-26/portfolio/security/advisories/new), or email singhalutkarsh26@gmail.com.

Include what you found, steps to reproduce, and the impact you expect. You will get a reply within 7 days, and a fix or a decision as soon as the issue is confirmed.
